style_compliance: Address: the strings carry no pronoun at all (verb-forward 需要 / 将 … 重新连接到), the zh-CN guide's preferred shape; no 您 anywhere

Full-width prose punctuation, verified by codepoint census rather than by eye: U+3002 IDEOGRAPHIC FULL STOP and U+3001 IDEOGRAPHIC COMMA in the remedy, U+FF08/U+FF09 FULLWIDTH PARENTHESES around the receipt's credential id. No ，(U+FF0C) is needed and none was substituted for the ideographic comma
The em dash is the doubled —— (two U+2014), the convention this namespace already ships (正在准备手机访问——更改前先检查…)

No space between Chinese and Latin runs — 同一Radient账户 and 凭据{id}. That is the zh-CN guide's explicit width rule ('No space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs'), the opposite of the more common pangu convention, so it is right as written and would be wrong if 'corrected'
No sentence-final 。 on the blocked-state title (guide: no 。 on short labels and statuses); the two full sentences keep theirs
Digits Latin; {id} renders as bare Latin digits with no grouping (the product passes str(row_id)), and Chinese has only the `other` plural category, which these strings do not invoke
No quotes needed or invented (mainland “ ” convention; 「」 not used)
naturalness: Reads written, not translated. 此设备上已有同一Radient账户的较新登录 is how a Chinese product states 'there is already a newer one of this on the device', and 将手机访问重新连接到该登录 is the standard 将 disposal imperative.

The one thing a native editor might raise is register, not meaning: 已为同一账户将… is a slightly formal fronting of 'for the same account', chosen (per the translator's receipt) because a trailing 同一账户 would read as a second, separate assertion. I agree with that reasoning and did not ask for a change.
该登录 is the correct anaphor for the sign-in just named (as opposed to 此设备 for 'this device'); the two demonstratives do not collide.

adjudications.topic: (c) 登录 for a sign-in *instance/row* — right, or does it need 登录凭据 to bind to the receipt's 凭据{id}?
adjudications.verdict: PASS — 登录 is right; no change
adjudications.reasoning: English itself separates the two objects: 'sign-in' in the prose and 'credential {id}' only in the parenthetical. The translation keeps exactly that split — 登录 in all three sentences, 凭据 only inside （凭据{id}）, which is the shipped parenthetical of mobile.setup.account. Widening to 登录凭据 would diverge from English by naming the row a credential in prose, and would then collide with the receipt's own 凭据{id}, reading as 'sign-in credential (credential {id})'. 登录 is also the namespace's established word for this object (title_login) and is understood as the instance in 较新的登录 / 较新登录 because 较新 needs a comparable noun, not a verb. Nothing in the copy is wrong.

observations_outside_this_delta: At the TUI notice's real body width (74 cells at 80 columns) the remedy wraps to 2 rows and the break falls inside the compound 同一账户 (…同一账 | 户、同一手机地址。). That is ordinary CJK per-character line breaking, not a defect: Chinese wraps between characters, and no punctuation rule is violated at that break.
The receipt (60 rendered cells) fits one row where the English source (93) takes two, and the title (38) fits where English (62) fits — so this locale never paints more rows than the source.
`mobile.setup` is not a `wire.*` namespace, so these strings never reach the phone client's bundled chunks; the surfaces are the CLI/TUI notice and the desktop remedy paragraph.

findings.issue: 登录 names the sign-in *instance* in all three sentences while the receipt's parenthetical names the row 凭据. A reader who pairs （凭据{id}） with 登录 in the sentence above it may wonder whether the sentence means the row or the act; 登录凭据 would bind the two explicitly.
findings.assessment: No change, and this is the correct split rather than an oversight. English makes the same distinction the translation does: 'sign-in' in the prose, 'credential {id}' only inside the parenthetical. Rendering it as 登录凭据 would (a) name in prose something English names only parenthetically, and (b) then read as 'sign-in credential (credential {id})' beside the receipt's own 凭据{id}. 登录 is also this namespace's established word for the object (mobile.setup.title_login 手机访问需要登录Radient, login, login_tui), and （凭据{id}） is byte-for-byte the shipped parenthetical of mobile.setup.account. Recorded as the adjudication the brief asked for; no edit requested. If a future wave wants to bind the two it must move all three keys together, as the translator noted.
